feeds.title: Trial and Error Collective
feeds.description: Trial and Error Collective is a group of music lovers from around the globe. The collective consists of writers, poets, visual artists, photographers, musicians, DJs, college burnouts, leaners, loafers, easy riders, and so on.

feeds.title: SoSco Duo Blog
feeds.description: Read stories of real wedding ceremonies & events played by some of the best musicians in Arizona. SoSco Duo is the premier flute and guitar duo in Arizona. Our award-winning duo has been providing top-notch musical entertainment for high-end weddings, private parties, and corporate events since 2014.

feeds.title: Music Celebrations Blog
feeds.description: MCI Journeys Blog is our way of keeping you informed of our latest music events, concert tours, and collaborations. We also offer a wealth of useful information for first-time tour organizers and experienced tour veterans alike.Music Celebrations provides unique performance and educational opportunities to music ensembles around the globe.

feeds.title: Arizona Friends of Chamber Music Blog
feeds.description: Arizona Friends of Chamber Music provides the world's greatest chamber music performed by the best chamber musicians anywhere, in a friendly and inviting atmosphere to the people of Southern Arizona.

feeds.title: Beneath a Desert Sky
feeds.description: Beneath a Desert Sky is your connection to Phoenix area concert photographs reviews and concert announcements. It is a live music blog dedicated to rock music and photographers who enjoy capturing it in still images. Covers rock in all of its incarnations - rock, alt-rock, classic rock, punk, indie, metal, and other genres.

feeds.title: MOON LVNDING
feeds.description: You've touched down at home-base for everything EDM and EDM-related news. This page includes everything from artist interviews, guest mixes, and breaking news about your favorite artists. Moon Lvnding is dance music media coverage that is out of this world! Our mission is to provide objective, professional and quality coverage of dance music across the globe.

feeds.title: Arizona Songwriters Association Blog
feeds.description: Arizona Songwriters Association offers writers the opportunity to learn more about the craft and business of songwriting through monthly workshops, educational programs, song pitch/critique sessions, and networking opportunities. Find out about their latest events with detailed articles in this blog.

feeds.title: Tucson Local Bands Blog
feeds.description: TucsonLocalBands.com is a one-stop guide to local music in Tucson. Discover musical musings, heartwarming fan and music stories, and more. The platform is also a directory of local talent. Find your favorite local bands and ways to support them.

feeds.title: Phoenix Conservatory Of Music Blog
feeds.description: Browse PCM's blog to follow their latest developments and programs. The Phoenix Conservatory Of Music is a creative Youth Development organization that provides a continuum of high-quality music education and experiences to nearly 2,000 students annually.

feeds.title: Phoenix Bangerz Blog
feeds.description: Phoenix Bangerz is the #1 Arizona based music blog covering what's really bangin! We are given the mission of empowering local artists & events while still covering mainstream news and bringing America 1 step closer to you.

feeds.title: Arizona Musicfest Blog
feeds.description: Arizona Musicfest aims to engage and delight audiences with exceptional concerts; promote and inspire young musicians through valuable performance and scholarship opportunities; and educate children and stimulate adults through dynamic music enrichment programs.

feeds.title: Flying Fiddlesticks Music Blog » Arizona
feeds.description: Flying Fiddlesticks Music Blog is dedicated to music for its own sake. We write recaps and reviews of music festivals and shows in order to promote live music as a life-improving experience. We cover new music releases and conduct interviews with artists to help get the word out.

feeds.title: The Musician's Portal
feeds.description: Featured updates and articles from The Musician's Portal. Learn from fellow music talents and access educational resources, tools, and opportunities for promotion and exposure. Connect with fellow musicians, learn new skills, and grow as an artist. The Musician's Portal is an online platform that provides a comprehensive set of resources to musicians, enabling them to succeed in their careers.

feeds.title: Arizona Professional DJ Blog
feeds.description: DJ Mathew Bolt is a professional DJ in Arizona offering DJ and Karaoke services since 1999. He discusses and answers common questions involving DJ services and also shares tips and insights on how to book the right DJ for a professional event.

feeds.title: phoenix.org » Music
feeds.description: Get to know the latest music news from Arizona with the Entertainer! Magazine. The Entertainer! is the No. 1 publication in Arizona that covers entertainment in multiple genres with statewide reach. More than 100,000 entertainment seekers read each exciting issue, packed with over 400 things to do, 10 specialized entertainment calendars, A-list celebrity interviews and a media-rich website at entertainermag.com.

feeds.title: YabYum Music and Arts
feeds.description: YabYum is an Arizona-based blog that's been in operation since 2009. Their cross-genre coverage includes music reviews, artist features, interviews, playlists, and more.

feeds.title: Quasar Qult » Arizona Music
feeds.description: Stay connected and witness the magic of Arizona's music world with Quasar Qult's dedicated page. Quasar Qult is a higher form of Qulture covering the latest news on entertainment, news, music, and more. Discover a vibrant showcase of arts and culture encompassing current popular events.

feeds.title: Music And Dance Academy Blog
feeds.description: Browse a growing collection of Music and Dance Academy Tucson blog articles. Here you will find the latest and wonderful topics that are essential to music and dance themes. Music And Dance Academy is a distinguished institution offering personalized instruction through private lessons, group classes, as well as master classes and workshops.

feeds.title: Music Lessons Arizona Blog
feeds.description: Learn practical tips, tricks, and lessons for mastering the Piano. Music Lessons Arizona is a site dedicated to enriching the lives of children and adults through classical piano study and performance. Owners Sherin Moustafa and Matt Friedland are dedicated to identifying your musical goals and helping students achieve them.

feeds.title: Have Notz Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date with Arizona hip hop artists Blaze and Sudz P. Have Notz blog is the perfect place to stay up to date on new music and video releases by Blaze and Sudz P. Also get notified on new deals and sales on the newest women and men's apparel from Have Notz.
